method.mode: two independent complete-scene generations: X profile concept and LinkedIn company-profile concept
method.reference_policy: The owner-provided Mayven phone image was used only for two-phone composition, crop, materials, lighting, and photorealistic finish. Mayven naming, cruise messaging, blue identity, and all other reference branding were prohibited.
method.qa_policy: Inspect each whole generated scene at original resolution; allow one targeted ImageGen retry only when the approximately 95% fidelity gate is missed; use exact raster compositing only after that retry.

inputs.role: device composition and finish reference only

x_profile.final_prompt: Create a premium photorealistic close-up of two smartphones presenting a Magic Mirror X profile concept, using the supplied phone image only as device-composition and material-finish direction. Use the exact supplied Acid icon and combined lockup. Show dark Ink screens, Acid editorial banner shapes, one primary profile view and one complementary crop. Required text: 'Magic Mirror'; '@magicmirror_demo'; 'AI virtual try-on for more confident clothing decisions. Hackathon prototype.'; 'CONCEPT PROFILE • NOT A LIVE ACCOUNT'. Preserve both focus corners. Prohibit verification badges, follower/following metrics, live-account claims, Mayven, cruise copy, blue branding, HTML/CSS screenshot appearance, unrelated logos, invented metrics, watermarks, hands, faces, and unreadable copy.

exact_raster_finishing.normalization_only: Accepted ImageGen scene resized from 1539x1022 to the planned 1536x1024 dimensions.

visual_qa.review_method: original-resolution direct visual inspection before and after dimension normalization

linkedin_profile.final_prompt: Create a premium photorealistic close-up of two smartphones presenting a Magic Mirror LinkedIn company-profile concept, using the supplied phone image only as device-composition and material-finish direction. Use the exact supplied Acid icon and combined lockup. Show dark Ink screens, Acid editorial banner shapes, one primary company view and one complementary crop. Required text: 'Magic Mirror'; 'AI-powered virtual try-on • Hackathon prototype'; 'Helping shoppers make faster, more confident clothing decisions.'; 'CONCEPT PROFILE • NOT A LIVE COMPANY PAGE'. Preserve both focus corners. Prohibit follower, customer, employee, or engagement metrics; verification badges; live-company-page claims; Mayven; cruise copy; blue branding; HTML/CSS screenshot appearance; unrelated logos; watermarks; hands; faces; and unreadable copy.

exact_raster_finishing.normalization_only: Accepted ImageGen scene resized from 1539x1022 to the planned 1536x1024 dimensions.

visual_qa.review_method: original-resolution direct visual inspection before and after dimension normalization

decision: Accepted both independent first-pass ImageGen scenes. Each is a page-ready raster device mockup with exact concept copy, explicit non-live labeling, approved Magic Mirror branding and Acid Dispatch colors, no invented metrics or verification claims, and no Mayven, cruise, blue reference branding, unrelated logo, or watermark.
